project_type: Monorepo with React/Vite web SPA and Expo/React Native mobile app (WebView-based player)
build_system: bun + vite (web), bun + expo (mobile). bun.lock at root and apps/mobile.
test_framework: Vitest for web (apps/web/tests/). No test files found for mobile.
build_command: cd apps/web && bun install && bun run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun install in apps/web. 2. Run bun run typecheck in apps/web. 3. Run bun run lint in apps/web. 4. Run bun run build in apps/web. 5. Run bun run test in apps/web. 6. For mobile: cd apps/mobile && bun install && npx tsc --noEmit (TypeScript check).
setup_instructions: cd apps/web && bun install (web surface). cd apps/mobile && bun install (mobile surface).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full access. No TMDB_API_KEY set locally so live API tests may be skipped. Mobile cannot be run/built without Android SDK but typecheck is possible.
contribution_requirements: Use bun as package manager. Run lint and typecheck before committing. Vitest for web tests. Typecheck via jsconfig.json.
key_patterns: Web player URL built in apps/web/src/utils/player.js (getMovieEmbedUrl, getTVEmbedUrl). Mobile player URL in apps/mobile/src/utils/player.js. Web Layout/topbar in apps/web/src/components/Layout.jsx. Mobile uses WebView for player (react-native-webview). Server transforms TMDB data in apps/server/src/index.js. Content grid rendering in ContentGrid.jsx. Embed URL base: https://vaplayer.ru/embed. VidAPI docs confirm: skin param (netflix/disney/prime/cinematic/vidzilla), resumeAt param (NOT t), ds_lang/lang for default subtitle language (ISO 639-1), sub_url for custom subtitles.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/ - React SPA (Vite). apps/mobile/src/ - Expo React Native with WebView player. apps/server/src/ - Bun server proxying TMDB API. apps/web/tests/ - Vitest integration/unit tests.
